candidates.name: Idle backlight dimming
candidates.user_value: Reduces glare and display power when unattended; BOOT interaction restores normal brightness.
candidates.implementation_cost: GPIO6 active-low PWM and one LEDC channel; no additional component, sensor task, or framebuffer.
candidates.risk: PWM polarity, visible brightness, flicker, and power benefit need measurement on the physical panel.
candidates.verification_method: Host test at 59,999/60,000 ms and monotonic reversal; board check of readability, flicker, and BOOT wake.
candidates.selection_reason: Useful on a continuously visible meter and isolated from the receiver/parser core.

candidates.name: IMU orientation indicator/page rotation
candidates.user_value: Could adapt a compact status view to device placement.
candidates.implementation_cost: QMI8658 over I2C; needs bus setup, reads, filtering, orientation thresholds, and page state.
candidates.risk: Automatic rotation conflicts with the fixed wide dashboard and may trigger on vibration or drift.
candidates.verification_method: Test four orientations, stationary drift, vibration, transition debounce, and return to landscape.
candidates.selection_reason: The product uses a fixed landscape layout and this adds a higher-risk interaction mode.

candidates.name: RTC-backed local-time confidence
candidates.user_value: Could show whether a local clock is usable when host time is unavailable.
candidates.implementation_cost: PCF85063 over I2C plus initialization, validity and set-time policy, and backup-power checks.
candidates.risk: Backup power is not guaranteed; a wrong RTC value could mislead source-age and reset-history displays.
candidates.verification_method: Test cold starts with backup power fitted/absent, unset RTC state, and timestamp preservation.
candidates.selection_reason: A local RTC is unnecessary for monotonic receive age and could falsely replace preserved source times.
